delivery.intro: Delivery anywhere in Azerbaijan is completely free. Courier, post or Expargo cargo, metro meetup — it doesn't matter, there's never an extra charge. Because your gift should arrive on time.

courier.title: Courier delivery
courier.desc: Delivered by courier to Baku and Sumgait. Orders are prepared and delivered within 1–3 days.

metro.title: Metro station meetup
metro.desc: Delivered to any Baku metro station — completely free. A dedicated time slot is arranged for you, on the day and hour that suits you.

regions.title: Post or Expargo cargo (Regions)
regions.desc: Sent to any region of Azerbaijan by post or the Expargo cargo company and arrives in about 2–3 days — completely free.

s3.title: Quality check
s3.desc: Every item is checked before shipping

f1.a: Yes, every delivery method is completely free. Courier (Baku and Sumgait), metro station meetup (any station), and post or Expargo cargo to the regions — all free of charge.

f2.a: The courier delivers your order on your chosen day. The exact time is set based on order sequence for that day. For example, if you choose August 12th, it will be delivered that same day.

f3.q: What is a metro station meetup?
f3.a: Delivery to any Baku metro station — completely free. A dedicated time slot is arranged for you, on the day and hour that suits you.

f4.q: How does delivery to the regions work?
f4.a: Everything outside Baku and Sumgait is shipped by post or the Expargo cargo company. Delivery is completely free and takes about 2–3 days.

f5.q: How long does an order take to prepare?
f5.a: Preparation takes 1 business day. On day 2 it's packaged and handed to the courier. Delivery happens on day 3, or on the day you choose. You'll be notified once your order is ready.

f6.a: Cancellation is possible before laser engraving begins. Once engraving has started, cancellation isn't possible — a personalized item can't be resold to another customer.

f7.q: Can I change the delivery time after ordering?
f7.a: Yes. Reply in the same WhatsApp chat you ordered from with your order number and the new date/time. Changes are possible before the item is dispatched. After you place an order, a “Change delivery time” button also appears in your cart.

about.seoDesc: Ravio — a Baku-based shop for personalized gifts. Laser engraving, free delivery, 5% of our monthly revenue goes to stray animals. Every item is made specially for you.
about.heroBody: Ravio is a personalized gift shop based in Baku. Every item is laser-engraved to order. 5% of our monthly revenue goes toward stray animals. Delivery is completely free.

p1.label: Delivery philosophy
p1.title: Free across Azerbaijan
p1.body: We don't charge for delivery — not in Baku, not in Sumgait, not anywhere in the country. Courier, metro meetup, post or Expargo cargo — all free. Because choosing a gift and then facing a delivery fee takes away the joy of that gift.

p2.label: Animal welfare philosophy
p2.title: 5% of monthly revenue to stray animals
p2.body: At the end of every month, 5% of our monthly revenue goes toward feeding, treating, and sheltering stray animals. This isn't a promotion — it's built into how our business works. When you buy a gift for someone you love, you're also doing good for someone else.

p3.label: Personalization philosophy
p3.title: Every gift, in your name
p3.body: Using laser technology, we engrave a name, date, message, even coordinates onto every item. What you buy doesn't look like it came from a store — it looks like it came from your heart. Nothing is mass-produced — every order is made, checked, and packaged individually.

s5.title: It reaches your door
s5.desc: Courier, metro, post or Expargo cargo — all completely free.

terms.seoTitle: Order terms, replacement and privacy | Ravio
terms.seoDesc: Every Ravio product is laser-engraved to order with the text and font you choose. Returns, replacement, payment, delivery and privacy rules.
terms.title: Order terms and privacy
terms.intro: Every Ravio product is made only for you, laser-engraved with the text and font you choose. Please read these terms before ordering.

s1.title: Custom orders
s1.body: All products sold at Ravio are made to order. The customer chooses the text (name, date, message) and the font on the site, and may add a photo. Once the choice is confirmed, the product is laser-engraved with exactly that text.

s2.title: Check your text
s2.body: Because the text and font are chosen by the customer, please check the letters, numbers and date carefully before sending the order. Once production starts, it may not be possible to change the text.

s3.title: Returns and refunds
s3.body: Each product is made for a specific customer with the text they chose, so it cannot be sold to anyone else. For this reason, finished products are not returned or refunded. For example, a bracelet engraved with a name the customer chose cannot later be sold to another person.

s4.title: If the mistake is ours
s4.body: If the problem comes from us (the engraving differs from the order, a spelling mistake in the engraving, or a material defect), the product is remade and delivered to you. To report it, contact us on WhatsApp after receiving the product and send a photo of the problem.

s5.title: Payment
s5.body: Because products are made to order, a 50% deposit is taken when the order is confirmed. The remainder is paid in cash or by card on delivery. The order is sent from the site to WhatsApp, and production starts after Ravio confirms it.

s6.title: Delivery and gift
s6.body: Delivery across Azerbaijan is free: courier in Baku and Sumgait, post or Expargo cargo to the regions (about 2–3 days) and metro meetup. Preparation takes 1–3 days. Every product comes with a small perfume as a gift. If you order a gift box or buy 3–4 products at once, you also receive a 20–30 ml perfume as a gift.

s7.title: Privacy
s7.body: Orders are placed via WhatsApp, so your name, phone and address are sent to us in the order message. The order record does not store name, phone, address or photo. The phone number is stored only as an irreversible hash. A photo you upload is stored by an external image hosting service so we can make your product. The site measures visits and ad results with Google Analytics and Meta Pixel. For any questions, message us on WhatsApp.
